title: Freeze first-slice icon vocabulary
summary: The first implementation slice uses the 58 canonical WebP icons and non-asset primitives; no new icon generation is allowed before the first slice passes QA.
rationale: The old frame plan implies hundreds of one-off icon concepts, but the canonical manifest deliberately reduces that to a reusable vocabulary.
evidence: All 58 manifest icon paths were checked as present in the workspace.
risks: If generated icons resume too early, the implementation can accumulate asset drift and inconsistent visual language.
